scope: Aggregate metadata-only diagnostic; no RNA values used
timing: Additional diagnostic after method registration, before RNA numerical parsing/scoring; source grouping concern already known
meaning: Source identifier grouping alone recovers the compound label. RNA label recovery in this panel cannot separate molecular response from plate/brew or normalization artifacts.
limits: This is an added metadata-only diagnostic after the primary plan was fixed; the confounding concern and source ID examples were already known. It is not a blinded or preregistered independent validation.
Every rule uses only source identifier prefixes, not RNA values, chemical structure or compound-name strings as a score. Candidate compound labels are used only to mark the correct candidate.
All 210 rows share a single study and reused panel structure. They are not 210 independent experiments or trials.

Perfect metadata-only label recovery means RNA cross-dose label recovery in this panel cannot by itself distinguish compound-specific molecular response from source plate/brew or normalization artifacts.
Identifier sharing establishes recorded source grouping, not proof that a batch effect exists in the RNA values or that every plate used identical physical controls.
Disjoint full signature/replicate IDs do not remove shared source plate/brew dependence. The primary fixed RNA method, 210 denominator, candidate rules and metrics are unchanged.
The existing gene-position permutation control is not a plate/brew-matched independent control and cannot by itself resolve this confounding.
No clinical, cancer, dietary, food-product, dose, human-exposure or treatment conclusion follows from this diagnostic.
